name: IDlink
startup_summary_v1: Uruguayan company providing DNA-based traceability and genomic certification for beef cattle exports. Uses genetic fingerprinting to authenticate origin and production practices from farm to export market enabling premium pricing in EU and US markets.
business_one_liner: DNA traceability and genomic certification for Uruguayan beef exports

name: Cargene
startup_summary_v1: Uruguayan animal genetics company providing genomic selection services and genetic testing for beef cattle and sheep breeding programs. Applies SNP genotyping and estimated breeding value analysis to accelerate genetic progress in Uruguayan livestock.
business_one_liner: Genomic selection and genetic testing for Uruguayan beef cattle and sheep

name: Wayki Technologies
startup_summary_v1: Peruvian precision agriculture startup using satellite and drone-based remote sensing combined with AI to provide crop monitoring and agronomic decision support to potato blueberry and asparagus growers in Peru's coastal and highland agricultural zones.
business_one_liner: Satellite and drone-based crop intelligence for Peruvian agriculture

name: Amazona Foods
startup_summary_v1: Peruvian company commercializing Amazonian superfoods and botanical ingredients — including sacha inchi camu camu maca and purple corn — as functional food ingredients and nutritional supplements for domestic and export markets leveraging Peru's exceptional Amazon biodiversity.
business_one_liner: Amazonian botanical superfood ingredients platform for export markets

name: Pangea Biosciences
startup_summary_v1: Paraguayan biotech startup developing bioinput solutions for soybean and corn production adapted to Paraguay's Chaco and Eastern Region soil conditions using native bacterial isolates with nitrogen fixation and phosphate solubilization capacity.
business_one_liner: Bioinputs from native bacterial strains for Paraguayan soybean and corn

name: BioAltura
startup_summary_v1: Panamanian agricultural biotech company developing biological inputs and integrated pest management solutions for banana plantain and tropical fruit production systems in Panama's Central and Chiriquí provinces.
business_one_liner: Biological inputs and IPM for Panamanian tropical fruit production
